notablePrerequisites:
Quicksilver Dagger and Basilisk Collar attached to Lurking Roper.
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent and causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
